name: a very alien xmas
source:
You play as a lone human on a deserted planet who longs for companionship and Christmas, and in this game, his wish is fulfilled!

[From [url=https://candycornskull.itch.io/a-very-alien-xmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个荒凉星球上的孤独人类，渴望陪伴和圣诞节，在这款游戏中，他的愿望得到了满足！

[来自[url=https://candycornskull.itch.io/a-very-alien-xmas]itch.io[/url]]
